## Driving conventions

- Always inspect linked `specContracts` and `invariants` (theorems, checkers, promoted gates) before driving runtime probes.
- Never run `cargo` or `rustc` on shared dev hosts; use prebuilt `norn` / `norn-dev-host` binaries (`scripts/dev/fetch-local-runtime.sh`) or CI / Boat sandboxes.
- Drive real user paths (CLI commands, HTTP API routes, Studio UI routes) in isolated temporary directories and ports; capture both the action and observable end state.
- Label evidence honestly (`checked-proof`, `exhaustive-finite`, `bounded`, `runtime-enforced`, `e2e-driven`, `unverified`). Never claim a bare "verified" or weaken a probe to make it pass.
